steps.content:
11:00 AM
DisCity Delegation Waiting Room
1 hour until the Unity Gala begins

Inside the room, every piece of anti-Mania equipment hums at maximum output. Aurum Secretum guards line the walls, their vigilant eyes fixed on the woman in the white hat seated at the room's center. Unfazed, she reclines in a custom chair, fanning herself with an air of utter leisure.

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: How are you feeling, Ms. Margaret?

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Sigh, after a full day in a farland prison transport, then brought straight here and held until now... how do you imagine I feel?
She tucks a stray strand of blonde hair behind her ear, the simple gesture underscored by a weary note in her otherwise composed voice.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: I am, of course, fully prepared to be your gala's sacrificial lamb.
The air in the room seems to solidify. A slow, knowing smile spreads across Marcus's lips.

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: Indeed, you are of great significance to today's proceedings.

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: In your decade here in Fraser, you've woven connections, cultivated friendships, and infiltrated every circle. Even our Senate is threaded with your influence. Within our carefully constructed narrative, you—DisCity's so-called "peace dove"—have thrived. Your performance during the Ash Campaign was particularly... remarkable.

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: You were the first to find the youngest Campbell daughter. The first to see her value. You extracted Aurum Secretum technical intelligence, breached our information blockade, and delivered it to DisCity—undoing years of strategic planning.

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: Heh, I could overlook past surprises. But even now, under constant watch, you've somehow reached the farland leadership and shaken their loyalty. Was securing the victory pact not enough? Must you destroy the very foundation of our alliance?

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: If you hadn't trusted that Campbell girl so completely, if you hadn't drawn her into your operations, the roles might be reversed today... What a waste. She held only marginal research value, yet you gave her all your faith and risked everything to protect her...

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Hypatia Campbell is a generational talent. To dismiss her as having "marginal research value" is absurd.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: I protected her because I cared for her. It was my choice. And you? Now that you have me, what revenge do you intend?

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: It's regrettable. You possess noble lineage, rare talent, and a genuine desire for peace. To see someone like you driven to such a corner... it pains us.

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: I know how you've been sidelined in DisCity, kept from the inner circle, denied policy support, betrayed repeatedly by Nirvana... Unpleasant, isn't it? And with the war-favoring DisCorps rising, your footing will grow even more precarious.

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: This is your last opportunity, Margaret. Join Fraser. The Senate values you. You'll have greater freedom to pursue your ideals. Besides... we both know your ties to DisCity are not so deep.

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: After all these years, you've integrated into Fraser's culture. I believe you've come to love this land and its rich heritage. Peace transcends allegiance. But only by removing DisCity's threat can you truly embrace your ideals.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Rich heritage... Fraser does have a rich heritage. But I wonder, how much of it was built upon the plundered blood and sweat of the farlands and your colonial satellite towns?

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: I love peace—true peace. Where people lay down arms, join hands, and move forward together. Not the counterfeit peace of the privileged, built upon trampled flesh and bones.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: In that regard, Fraser cannot offer what I seek. I must respectfully decline.
Margaret taps her cheek with the tip of her fan, offering a definitive refusal.
Marcus never truly expected to persuade her. In fact, her refusal is essential. Without it, the grand spectacle he has planned would have no conflict.
He lets his facade of warmth dissolve, revealing the cold ambition beneath.

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: ...Heh... Hahahaha! Do you truly believe you can turn the tables? As you have with your silver tongue so many times before? What is your plan?

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: Expose BR-003? Reveal the so-called "Fraser lies"? Or return home and force Nirvana to concede more benefits, to bribe those gullible souls outside?
He methodically outlines every strategy Margaret might attempt, having already sealed off each path long before she could take a single step.

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: Wake up. It's futile. You know how long we have cultivated this. To the farlanders, Fraser is not just an ally against common enemies; we are the hand that relieves their suffering, the only god who answers their desperate prayers!

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: You—an outsider, a Disian—think you can shake a century-old alliance? Like an ant trying to topple a mountain!
Just then, the host's countdown echoes from behind the heavy curtain. Marcus turns, lifting a corner of the velvet drape with one finger.
His view from backstage takes in the circular hall, now packed with farland representatives. Among them, his carefully placed "agitators" wait.
But he may not even need them. A raw, palpable hatred already burns in the eyes of the crowd, countless gazes fixed on the empty platform where the DisCity representative will stand.
Marcus smiles. This is exactly the audience he wanted.

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: Well... the hypocritical peace dove of DisCity, struck down by vengeful farlanders. Oppressors slain by freedom fighters. The resistance reignited. Conflict burning eternal... Not a bad "contribution" from you to this gala.

12:00 PM
Top of Fraser Gold Palace
The Unity Gala officially begins
Above Gold Palace Square, birds take flight as parade floats and fireworks erupt in unison. A torrent of ribbons and petals falls like rain, washing the sky in flowing gold and purple.

At the peak of the Gold Palace, heavy curtains part to the swell of ceremonial music. The Fraser senators appear as the event's hosts, and standing alongside them is the Peace Ambassador from DisCity: Margaret Kervoz.
She stands apart, isolated like a defendant in a dock.
At her appearance, a low murmur of unrest begins to ripple through the farland representatives.

An Aurum Secretum Warrior shoulders through the crowd, her eyes burning with a hatred so palpable it seems to scorch the air. Her left leg, mangled by Aurum Secretum, drags with a heavy, unnatural gait as she advances. An Aurum Secretum blade is gripped in her white-knuckled hand, sparking against the floor with every step.
Marcus raises a hand, halting the guards who move to intercept. He watches Saina's approach with cold fascination, the ghost of a smile touching his lips.

Saina takes her place at the front of the crowd. Her gaze sweeps past Margaret, fixing instead on the Fraser senators at the center of the platform. Slowly, deliberately, she raises her Aurum Secretum blade, leveling its tip at their elegantly dressed ranks.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: It was always you... behind all the suffering in the farlands... it was—ALWAYS—YOU!

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: <color=#fb9259><size=52>GO TO HELL, YOU FRASER BASTARDS!</color></size>
The raw fury in her cry sends a chill through the Fraser nobles. They had expected a warrior consumed by blind rage to execute Margaret before the crowd—not to turn the blade on Fraser itself!!

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: What?! How dare you—!
Events erupt. Saina launches forward like a loosed arrow. The guards, originally ordered to permit the attack, now scramble to intercept. But it's too late.
She drives her heel into a guard's chest, catapulting him backward onto the signing table. Ceremonial vessels shatter; documents scatter. The hall plunges into instant chaos.

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Aaarrrgh! HELP!!

The orderly conference hall fractures into a battlefield. Saina drives forward against the tide of bodies—slow, relentless, propelled by a desperate will as she claws her way toward the platform where the senators stay.
Amid the turmoil, Margaret remains serenely seated. She unfolds her fan with a practiced grace, letting it shield the subtle curve of her lips.
Her eyes meet Marcus's across the chaos, holding his look of shock and fury. And then, very deliberately, she smiles.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: I need not lift a finger now. Everything that needed to be done... was already arranged.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Shall we watch the spectacle unfold together?
The moment her words fade, Saina's blade splits the wooden podium in two. Splinters explode into the air, and with them, Marcus's carefully constructed script is destroyed.
